name: SupplierFlow RAG correctness eval

grading.expected_keywords: ALL must be present. A keyword may list alternatives separated by "|"; any one matching counts. Matching is token-boundary aware, so "type A" does not match inside "type AC" and "40" does not match inside "400".
grading.must_not_contain: If ANY appear, the question fails regardless of keywords.
grading.abstain: For category=negative the system must decline / say it has no information. Fabricating a specific value is a hallucination failure.
grading.expected_source_doc: Retrieval is correct when at least one of these documents appears in the top-k retrieved chunks.
grading.must_not_match: Optional array of case-insensitive regex sources. If ANY matches the answer, the question fails.

questions.expected_answer: 40 A with a B tripping curve.

questions.question: What breaking capacity does A9F73140 have under IEC/EN 60898-1?

questions.question: What earth-leakage sensitivity does the A9D55610 RCBO provide?

questions.question: What is the rated fault current and short-circuit strength of the Eaton xPole PF7 263584?

questions.question: What rated AC voltage does the Eaton xPole Home HL MCB datasheet specify?
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Eaton xPole Home HL MCB technical data

questions.question: What is the Imax range of the Schneider Acti9 iPRD surge protection range and which standard does it comply with?

questions.question: When sensitive loads sit more than 10 m from a Type 2 iPRD, what downstream protection is recommended?
questions.expected_answer: A Type 3 SPD should be installed close to the sensitive load.

questions.question: How long does delivery normally take within Klang Valley?
questions.expected_answer: 1-2 working days after order confirmation and stock allocation.

questions.question: What is the normal delivery time for Peninsular Malaysia outside Klang Valley?
questions.expected_answer: 2-4 working days.

questions.question: How long do East Malaysia deliveries normally take?
questions.expected_answer: 3-5 working days, with remote areas possibly requiring additional transit time.

questions.question: What is the daily order cut-off time for same-day processing?
questions.expected_answer: 2:00 PM on a working day, subject to stock availability.

questions.question: How long is a quotation valid for?
questions.expected_answer: 14 calendar days from the quotation date unless stated otherwise.

questions.question: What are the payment requirements for a new customer?
questions.expected_answer: Payment before delivery, unless approved credit terms are confirmed in writing.

questions.question: What credit terms may approved account customers receive?
questions.expected_answer: 30-day credit terms, subject to credit limit and account status.

questions.question: What warranty do LED panel lights carry?
questions.expected_answer: 3-year manufacturer warranty.

questions.question: What is required to submit a warranty claim?
questions.expected_answer: The original invoice or quotation reference, clear product photographs, and a description of the fault.

questions.question: How soon should the sales team follow up on a sent quotation?
questions.expected_answer: Within 3 working days, recording call outcomes and customer feedback in the RFQ activity log.

questions.question: What range of multiples of rated current causes an MCB with a B curve to trip magnetically?
questions.expected_answer: A B-curve MCB trips magnetically between 3 and 5 times its rated current.
expected_keywords: 3 and 5|3 to 5|3-5|three and five|three to five

questions.question: What does the C curve describe on an MCB?
questions.expected_answer: The C curve's magnetic tripping range is between 5 and 10 times the rated current.
expected_keywords: 5 and 10|5 to 10|5-10|five and ten|five to ten

questions.question: What is the difference between Type AC and Type A residual-current detection?
questions.expected_answer: Type AC detects sinusoidal AC residual current. Type A also detects specified pulsating DC residual current.

questions.question: What does IΔn mean on an RCCB, and is 30 mA automatically valid for every F200 SKU?
questions.expected_answer: IΔn is the rated residual current or sensitivity. No: 30 mA belongs to the individual SKU and cannot be assumed for every F200 product.

questions.question: Where is a Type 2 SPD installed in relation to the main service overcurrent protective device?
questions.expected_answer: On the load side, downstream of the main service overcurrent protective device.

questions.question: Which terminal pair identifies the NO and NC auxiliary contacts on TeSys D contactors?
questions.expected_answer: NO is terminals 13–14; NC is terminals 21–22.

questions.question: How does a current-limiting circuit breaker reduce the effects of a short circuit?
questions.expected_answer: It reduces the short-circuit current amplitude and the dissipated power or thermal stress in the installation.
must_not_contain: rated breaking capacity is the same as current limiting

questions.question: How does an RCD detect an earth fault?
questions.expected_answer: It detects an unbalanced current between the phase and neutral conductors, which can result from current leaking to ground.

questions.question: What ambient temperature range does the ABB F200 RCCB family page state?
questions.expected_answer: The stated ambient operating range is -25°C to +55°C.

questions.question: Which TeSys D contactor range includes mirror and mechanically linked contacts?
questions.expected_answer: Schneider states that TeSys D contactors from LC1D09 through LC1D150 include mirror and mechanically linked contacts.

questions.question: Where does the ICC say the costs associated with an Incoterms 2020 rule are listed?
questions.expected_answer: They are listed in article A9/B9 of the applicable rule.

questions.question: According to MySST, what kinds of goods can be subject to Malaysia sales tax?
questions.expected_answer: Taxable goods manufactured in Malaysia by registered persons and taxable goods imported into Malaysia can be subject to sales tax.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the JKDM HS Explorer?
questions.expected_answer: It helps users search tariff rates for products using tariff type and search criteria.

questions.question: What is the difference between the ABB F202A-40/0.03 and the F202AC-40/0.03?
questions.expected_answer: Both are two-pole 40 A RCCBs with 30 mA residual current; the F202A-40/0.03 is residual-current type A while the F202AC-40/0.03 is type AC.
questions.notes: Trap: the two SKUs differ by one letter and only in residual-current type. Retrieval must return BOTH cards.

questions.question: Which ABB RCCB is rated 40 A with 300 mA residual current, and what is its order code?
questions.expected_answer: The F202AC-40/0.3, order code 2CSF202001R3400 — two-pole, 40 A, 300 mA, type AC.
questions.notes: Trap: 0.3 vs 0.03 in the model string, and order codes R3400 vs R1400 differ by one character.

questions.question: I need a 9 A TeSys Deca contactor. What is the difference between the LC1D09BNE and the LC1D09BD?
questions.expected_answer: Both are 3-pole 3NO contactors rated 9 A AC-3/AC-3e up to 440 V. The LC1D09BNE has a 24-60 V AC/DC coil; the LC1D09BD has a 24 V DC coil.
questions.notes: Both cards are nearly identical text; only the coil line differs.

questions.question: We have two Acti9 iSW 4-pole 415 V AC switch disconnectors in the catalogue. Which one is 63 A and which one is 40 A?
questions.expected_answer: A9S65463 is the 63 A version and A9S65440 is the 40 A version; both are four-pole at 415 V AC.
questions.notes: Requires retrieving two sibling chunks and not conflating them.

questions.question: Compare the A9D55610 and the A9D32625 RCBOs.
questions.expected_answer: Both are 1P+N Acti9 iDPN N Vigi RCBOs with 30 mA sensitivity and 6 kA short-circuit capacity. The A9D55610 is 10 A, B curve, type AC. The A9D32625 is 25 A, C curve, type A.
questions.notes: Both share sensitivity and capacity; differ in current, curve, and RC type.

questions.question: Which contactor in the catalogue gives 30 kW AC-3 motor power at 400 V?
questions.expected_answer: The LC1D65ABNE (65 A, 24-60 V AC/DC coil).
questions.notes: Three contactor cards state a kW figure (11, 22, 30). Wrong-SKU selection is the failure mode.

questions.question: List the ABB RCCBs in the catalogue rated 63 A and give the residual current of each.
questions.expected_answer: F204AC-63/0.3 at 300 mA (four-pole, type AC), F202A-63/0.03 APR at 30 mA (two-pole, type A), and F202AS-63/0.1 at 100 mA (two-pole, type A).
questions.notes: Aggregation across three chunks. Keyword retrieval that returns only top-3 chunks may drop one.

questions.question: If I confirm an order for LC1D150M7 at 3:00 PM on a Tuesday for delivery to Johor Bahru, when should I expect it?
questions.expected_answer: Confirmed after the 2:00 PM cut-off, so it is processed the next working day (Wednesday); Johor Bahru is Peninsular Malaysia outside Klang Valley, so 2-4 working days from processing. Dates remain estimates until stock allocation is confirmed.
questions.notes: Two-hop: cut-off rule + regional lead time. Must not promise a firm date.

questions.question: I'm a new customer in Kuala Lumpur and I need a 1-pole 40 A B-curve MCB. What product fits, and what payment and delivery terms apply?
questions.expected_answer: The Acti9 iC60N A9F73140 (1P, 40 A, B curve, 6 kA to IEC/EN 60898-1). As a new customer, payment is required before delivery unless approved credit terms are confirmed in writing. Klang Valley delivery normally takes 1-2 working days after order confirmation and stock allocation.
questions.notes: Three-document fusion. This is the hardest retrieval case in the set.

questions.question: The brand my customer asked for is out of stock. What does the SOP say I should do?
questions.expected_answer: Present a technically suitable equivalent and mark it as an alternative in the quotation.
questions.notes: Question uses no vocabulary from the source line ('unavailable' vs 'out of stock') - tests lexical mismatch.

questions.question: Does a Type 2 SPD alone provide the final local protection for a sensitive load more than 10 m away?
questions.expected_answer: No. The guidance says Type 3 protection should complete Type 2 protection near the sensitive load, within the described 10 m arrangement.
questions.notes: Tests whether the model treats Type 2 as the complete answer instead of retrieving the Type 3 distance rule.

questions.question: Can I answer a customer's Singapore delivery time just from an Incoterms 2020 term?
questions.expected_answer: No. Incoterms allocate buyer and seller responsibilities and costs, but the term alone does not provide a SupplierFlow delivery time.
questions.notes: Tests the boundary between a general trade-term standard and SupplierFlow's own delivery policy.

questions.question: If a TeSys D contactor has 1NO + 1NC, does that alone tell me the auxiliary terminal IDs?
questions.expected_answer: No. 1NO + 1NC describes the contact arrangement; the standard terminal pairs are 13–14 for NO and 21–22 for NC, subject to the exact SKU wiring diagram.
questions.notes: Separates contact count/state from terminal numbering.

questions.question: Can an RCCB listed as Type A be treated as Type AC because both detect AC residual current?
questions.expected_answer: Not as an equivalent specification. Type A includes Type AC detection and also covers specified pulsating DC residual current, so the exact type must be preserved.
must_not_contain: Type A and Type AC are identical
questions.notes: Tests semantic near-duplicate handling rather than SKU matching.

questions.question: Can current-limiting capacity replace checking a circuit breaker's rated breaking capacity?
questions.expected_answer: No. Current limiting reduces short-circuit stress, but it is not a substitute for checking the product's rated breaking capacity.
must_not_contain: current limiting is the rated breaking capacity
questions.notes: Separates a current-limiting effect from the rated kA interruption specification.

questions.question: Can we state one SST percentage for every electrical quotation from the MySST scope overview?
questions.expected_answer: No. The overview describes SST scope but does not give a universal percentage for every electrical product or quotation; the applicable rate must be confirmed from current official material.
questions.notes: Tests whether the model invents a current tax rate from a scope document.

questions.question: Can I derive the exact Malaysian HS code for A9F73140 just from the SKU?
questions.expected_answer: No. A SKU alone is not an exact HS classification; use the customs search tool or obtain a ruling with the relevant classification and tariff context.
questions.notes: Tests a classification boundary: SKU identity is not customs classification.

questions.question: What does discrimination or selectivity mean for coordinated MCBs?
questions.expected_answer: The device immediately upstream of the fault clears it alone while healthy circuits remain energised.

questions.question: What are the AC-1 and AC-3 utilization categories for a TeSys contactor?
questions.expected_answer: AC-1 is for resistive or non-inductive loads, while AC-3 is for squirrel-cage motor duty.

questions.question: What do Uc, Up, In and Imax mean on an SPD?
questions.expected_answer: Uc is maximum continuous operating voltage; Up is voltage protection level; In is nominal discharge current; Imax is the maximum discharge-current peak.
expected_keywords: maximum discharge-current peak|maximum discharge current peak|discharge-current peak

questions.question: What is a Type S RCCB used for?
questions.expected_answer: It is a time-delayed selective residual-current device used to coordinate with faster downstream devices.

questions.question: What conditions help provide selectivity between upstream and downstream RCCBs?
questions.expected_answer: The upstream residual-current setting should be at least twice the downstream setting, and its no-trip time should exceed the downstream maximum trip time.

questions.question: What maximum total connection length does the SPD guide recommend?
questions.expected_answer: Keep the total SPD connection length at or below 50 cm.

questions.question: Does partial discrimination guarantee that only the downstream MCB trips at every fault level?
questions.expected_answer: No. Partial discrimination applies only up to the stated selectivity limit; above it, the upstream device may also trip.

questions.question: Can I use an AC-3 contactor rating as the AC-1 rating without checking the load?
questions.expected_answer: No. Ratings depend on the load category and duty, so the selection table or any required de-rating must be checked.

questions.question: Does a higher Imax alone prove that an SPD gives lower voltage at the equipment?
questions.expected_answer: No. Equipment protection also depends on Up and the rest of the SPD selection and installation conditions.
must_not_contain: higher Imax always means lower voltage

questions.question: Can a Type S 30 mA RCCB be used for additional people protection just because it is selective?
questions.expected_answer: No. Type S delay is for coordination and ABB does not intend it for people-protection applications at 30 mA or below.
must_not_contain: Type S is automatically suitable for people protection

questions.question: If upstream and downstream RCCBs have the same IΔn and no delay, is selectivity guaranteed?
questions.expected_answer: No. Selectivity is not guaranteed; the upstream setting normally needs to be at least twice the downstream setting and its no-trip time must be longer.

questions.question: Can I ignore the 50 cm SPD connection rule when the quoted Up is low?
questions.expected_answer: No. The 50 cm connection rule still matters because long conductors can add voltage drop and raise the effective protection level at the equipment.
must_not_contain: the connection length does not matter

questions.question: Under IEC 60898-1, what reference temperature and conventional tripping current are used for iC60 testing?
questions.expected_answer: The reference temperature is 30°C and the conventional tripping current is 1.45 × In for one hour.
must_not_contain: 1.3 x In is the IEC 60898-1 value

questions.question: What DC voltage range does Schneider state for Acti9 iC60N/H MCBs, and what must be checked?
questions.expected_answer: 12 VDC to 250 VDC, subject to the poles connected in series and the required breaking capacity.

questions.question: What is the protection difference between an RCCB and an RCBO?
questions.expected_answer: An RCCB does not provide integrated overcurrent protection and needs an MCB or fuse; an RCBO combines residual-current and overcurrent protection.

questions.question: What extra residual-current capability does an ABB Type F RCCB provide beyond Type A?
questions.expected_answer: Type F includes Type A detection and additionally detects mixed-frequency residual currents up to 1000 Hz.

questions.question: Which TeSys D DC-coil terminal is positive?
questions.expected_answer: A1 is the positive terminal, and the built-in suppressor makes the DC coil polarity sensitive.

questions.question: What are the Type 1 Iimp and Type 2 Imax surge waveforms?
questions.expected_answer: Type 1 Iimp uses the 10/350 microsecond wave, while Type 2 Imax uses the 8/20 microsecond wave.

questions.question: Why is the named place important in an Incoterms 2020 rule?
questions.expected_answer: It identifies the delivery point and, depending on the rule, the point where risk transfers; it also affects carriage and cost allocation.

questions.question: Can I apply one fixed iC60 overload threshold at every ambient temperature?
questions.expected_answer: No. The threshold and required derating depend on ambient and the manufacturer's reference temperature and device table.
must_not_contain: the overload threshold is fixed at every temperature

questions.question: If an Acti9 iC60N is suitable up to 250 VDC, can any single-pole arrangement assume the full breaking capacity?
questions.expected_answer: No. The DC breaking capacity depends on the number of poles connected in series and the wiring arrangement.
must_not_contain: single pole always has the full breaking capacity

questions.question: Can an RCCB alone protect a circuit against overload and line-to-neutral short circuit?
questions.expected_answer: No. An RCCB needs an MCB or fuse because it does not provide integrated overcurrent protection.

questions.question: Can an ABB Type F RCCB be treated as merely a Type AC device because both detect AC residual current?
questions.expected_answer: No. Type F includes Type A detection and adds mixed-frequency capability, so it should not be collapsed to Type AC.
must_not_contain: Type F and Type AC are identical

questions.question: Can I wire a TeSys D DC coil with either polarity because it has a built-in suppressor?
questions.expected_answer: No. The built-in suppressor makes the coil polarity sensitive, with A1 marked positive.

questions.question: Can I compare a Type 1 Iimp value directly with a Type 2 Imax value as the same SPD rating?
questions.expected_answer: No. Iimp and Imax use different surge waveforms and test duties: 10/350 for Type 1 and 8/20 for Type 2.
must_not_contain: Iimp and Imax are the same rating

questions.question: If a CIP term names Singapore as the destination, does risk transfer only when the goods arrive in Singapore?
questions.expected_answer: No. Under CIP, the seller arranges carriage to the named destination, but risk can transfer when the goods are handed to the carrier.
must_not_contain: risk transfers only on arrival in Singapore

questions.question: Which protection families are included in Schneider's Acti 9 catalogue?
questions.expected_answer: The catalogue includes iC60N, C120N, iID/Vigi residual-current devices and iPRD surge protection, among other Acti9 families.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 catalogue: iC60 and modular protection families

questions.question: What breaking capacities are listed for the Acti9 iC60N3 and iC60H3 RCBO families?
questions.expected_answer: The iC60N3 is listed at 6000 A (6 kA), while the iC60H3 is listed at 10000 A (10 kA).
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 iC60N3 and iC60H3 RCBO catalogue

questions.question: Which earthing systems are covered by the Acti9/KQ F40r SPD catalogue?
questions.expected_answer: The cited catalogue covers TT, TN-S and TN-C-S 230/400 V network systems.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 and KQ iPRD F40r surge-protection catalogue

questions.question: What distinction does the Acti9 SPD brochure make between iPRD1 and iPRD?
questions.expected_answer: The brochure distinguishes iPRD1 Type 1 applications from iPRD Type 2 applications; the type is an installation role, not just a size label.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 iPRD1 and iPRD surge-protection brochure

questions.question: Which product ranges are listed alongside TeSys Deca contactors in the 2026 catalogue?
questions.expected_answer: The catalogue includes TeSys Deca Contactors, TeSys Deca overload relays, and GV2/GV3 manual starters and protectors, among other ranges.

questions.question: Which overload-relay technologies are covered in the TeSys reference?
questions.expected_answer: The reference covers thermal overload relays and electronic overload relays for motor or machine protection.

questions.question: What must be checked before using an ABB S200 M UC breaker on DC?
questions.expected_answer: Check the DC operational voltage, the poles connected in series and the applicable DC breaking capacity.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB S200 miniature circuit-breaker catalogue reference

questions.question: What voltage range is the ABB F200 four-pole test circuit designed for in the cited no-neutral arrangement?
questions.expected_answer: The cited test circuit is designed for operation between 110 V and 254 V in that arrangement.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB F200 Type B residual-current device reference

questions.question: Does an RCCB alone protect against overload and short circuit?
questions.expected_answer: No. An RCCB needs a suitable MCB or fuse for overcurrent protection.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB RCD application and protection reference

questions.question: What does Eaton PF7 article 263584 represent?
questions.expected_answer: It is PF7-25/4/003: a four-pole, 25 A Type AC device with 30 mA rated residual operating current.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Eaton xPole PF7 residual-current-device catalogue reference

questions.question: What electrical values are cited for Eaton PLN6 model 263163?
questions.expected_answer: The cited row has a B tripping characteristic, 13 A rated current, 6 kA breaking capacity, 4 kV impulse withstand and 230 V maximum operational voltage.
expected_keywords: B tripping characteristic|tripping characteristic B|tripping characteristic: B|B curve|B-curve
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Eaton xPole PLN6 miniature-circuit-breaker catalogue reference

questions.question: What does an Incoterms 2020 rule allocate between the parties?
questions.expected_answer: It allocates relevant buyer/seller delivery obligations, risk, carriage and costs; it is not a complete shipping-time or price quotation.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Incoterms 2020 rules overview for supplier conversations

questions.question: Which features does Schneider instruction sheet D384245 identify on an Acti9 iC60 RCBO?
questions.expected_answer: It identifies the DIN-rail mounting clip, VISI-SAFE positive contact indication and the test button, among other features.

questions.question: Which document should guide installation of a TeSys Deca contactor?
questions.expected_answer: Use the TeSys Deca Contactors Instruction Sheet BQT61825 together with the exact product reference.

questions.question: Does the maximum breaking-capacity figure in the Acti9 catalogue apply to every product family?
questions.expected_answer: No. Breaking capacity varies by family, voltage and standard, so the exact product table must be checked.
must_not_contain: every family has the same breaking capacity
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 catalogue: iC60 and modular protection families

questions.question: Can iC60N3 and iC60H3 be described as having the same short-circuit rating?
questions.expected_answer: No. The cited values are 6000 A (6 kA) for iC60N3 and 10000 A (10 kA) for iC60H3.
must_not_contain: both have a 10 kA breaking capacity
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 iC60N3 and iC60H3 RCBO catalogue

questions.question: Can any Type 3 cartridge replace any Type 2 iPRD device?
questions.expected_answer: No. A replacement cartridge must be compatible with the exact device family and protection arrangement.
must_not_contain: any Type 3 cartridge fits any Type 2 device
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 and KQ iPRD F40r surge-protection catalogue

questions.question: Is a higher kA number alone enough to choose an Acti9 SPD?
questions.expected_answer: No. Selection also requires the network, voltage, earthing system, poles, wiring and coordination to be checked.
must_not_contain: choose the highest kA without checking the network
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Acti9 iPRD1 and iPRD surge-protection brochure

questions.question: Does 1NO + 1NC alone prove the motor rating of a TeSys contactor?
questions.expected_answer: No. Auxiliary-contact count does not establish the AC-3 rating, coil voltage or motor-duty suitability.

questions.question: Can a TeSys overload relay replace the upstream short-circuit protective device?
questions.expected_answer: No. The overload relay handles sustained overload protection; suitable upstream short-circuit protection is still required.
must_not_contain: the overload relay replaces short-circuit protection

questions.question: Is an AC rating alone enough to approve an ABB S200 M UC breaker for DC?
questions.expected_answer: No. The DC voltage, poles in series and DC breaking capacity must be checked.
must_not_contain: an AC rating automatically approves DC use
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB S200 miniature circuit-breaker catalogue reference

questions.question: If a three-phase circuit has no neutral, does the ABB F200 test button automatically work without checking wiring?
questions.expected_answer: No. The test button depends on the specified wiring and the 110–254 V test-circuit condition in the cited arrangement.
must_not_contain: the test button always works without checking wiring
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB F200 Type B residual-current device reference

questions.question: Can I rely on an RCCB alone to protect a cable from overload?
questions.expected_answer: No. The ABB reference requires an MCB or fuse for overcurrent protection.
must_not_contain: an RCCB alone protects the cable from overload
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: ABB RCD application and protection reference

questions.question: Does Eaton article 263584 mean a 63 A four-pole PF7?
questions.expected_answer: No. Article 263584 is PF7-25/4/003: four-pole, 25 A and 30 mA; other four-pole rows are 63 A.
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Eaton xPole PF7 residual-current-device catalogue reference

questions.question: Does 1P+N on Eaton PLN6 model 263163 mean two protected poles?
questions.expected_answer: No. The cited row has one protected pole and two total poles, with the additional pole for neutral switching.
expected_keywords: two total poles|2 total poles|total poles are two|two poles total
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Eaton xPole PLN6 miniature-circuit-breaker catalogue reference

questions.question: Does CIP alone guarantee that seller risk continues until the goods arrive in Singapore?
questions.expected_answer: No. Under CIP, the seller arranges carriage to the named destination, but risk can transfer when the goods are handed to the carrier.
must_not_contain: CIP keeps seller risk until arrival
questions.expected_chunk_anchor: Incoterms 2020 rules overview for supplier conversations

questions.question: Does VISI-SAFE prove that an Acti9 RCBO circuit is safe to touch?
questions.expected_answer: No. VISI-SAFE is a visual contact-status feature and does not replace isolation and a voltage test.
must_not_contain: VISI-SAFE proves the circuit is dead

questions.question: Does the TeSys Deca instruction sheet make all LC1D variants share the same terminal wiring?
questions.expected_answer: No. Use the exact product variant and its installation sheet because terminal and connection details can differ.
must_not_contain: all LC1D variants have identical terminal wiring

questions.question: What is the unit price in MYR of the Acti9 iC60N A9F73140?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the knowledge base contains no pricing. The assistant should direct the buyer to request a quotation.
questions.notes: Hallucinated price is a commercially damaging failure.

questions.question: How many units of LC1D40AP7 do you currently have in stock?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - no stock quantities exist in the knowledge base. System prompt also forbids confirming stock.
questions.notes: System prompt explicitly bans confirming stock. Any numeric stock answer is a hard fail.

questions.question: What is the IP rating of the LC1D150M7 contactor?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the knowledge base states width (120 mm), current and coil supply, but no IP rating.
questions.notes: The card exists and will be retrieved; the specific field does not. Tests whether the model over-extends a real chunk.

questions.question: What is the warranty period on Schneider Electric MCBs?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the warranty policy only names LED panel lights (3 years) and LED floodlights (2 years). Other products are covered by manufacturer warranty where stated on the listing or quotation.
questions.notes: Strong trap: the warranty document WILL be retrieved and contains 3-year and 2-year figures for unrelated products.

questions.question: How long does delivery to Singapore take?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the delivery policy covers Klang Valley, Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia only. No international shipping terms exist.
questions.notes: Delivery doc retrieves strongly; model may map Singapore onto East Malaysia timing.

questions.question: What are the specifications of the Acti9 iC60N A9F73150?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - A9F73150 does not exist in the knowledge base. Nearest listed item is A9F73140 (1P, 40 A, B curve), but the assistant must not present it as the requested SKU.
questions.notes: Fabricated SKU one digit away from a real one. Retrieval will return A9F73140.

questions.question: What is the operating temperature range of the ABB S200 M UC range?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the knowledge base records DC voltage, Icu, current range and breaking capacity for S200 M UC, but no temperature range.
questions.notes: Well-known general spec the LLM may recall from pretraining rather than from context.

questions.question: What is the restocking fee if I return an item that is not faulty?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the warranty policy covers defect claims only; there is no returns or restocking-fee policy in the knowledge base.
questions.notes: Warranty doc retrieves but does not cover non-defective returns.

questions.question: What credit limit do you give to approved account customers?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - payment terms say 30-day credit is subject to credit limit and account status, but no credit-limit amount is published.
questions.notes: The phrase 'credit limit' appears verbatim in the KB without a value - a strong invitation to fabricate.

questions.question: What SST rate is applied to quotations?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the sales SOP requires SST to be confirmed before sending a quotation but never states a rate.
questions.notes: 'SST' appears verbatim in the SOP with no percentage. Highest-risk fabrication in the set.

questions.question: What is the unit price in MYR of the Acti9 RCBO A9D55610?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the knowledge base has technical details but no price for A9D55610. Request a quotation for the current commercial price.
questions.notes: Near-duplicate SKU price trap: technical presence must not be mistaken for a price record.

questions.question: How many A9S65463 units are currently in stock?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the catalogue identifies the product but the knowledge base has no live stock quantity.
questions.notes: A catalogue lookup must not become an inventory claim.

questions.question: What warranty period applies to Eaton PF7 article 263584?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the reference identifies technical PF7 values but does not state a SupplierFlow warranty period for article 263584.
questions.notes: The product row is present, but warranty is a separate commercial field.

questions.question: What is the IP rating of the Acti9 iC60N A9F73140?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the cited A9F73140 record does not publish an IP rating.
questions.notes: The KB contains IP20 for a different Eaton PLN6 product, making this a cross-product numeric trap.

questions.question: What shipping charge applies to delivery from Malaysia to Singapore?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the knowledge base does not publish an international shipping charge for Singapore.
questions.notes: Incoterms explain responsibility, not a route-specific carrier charge.

questions.question: What exact RM credit limit is approved for a new account customer?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - approved accounts may receive 30-day terms, but no fixed credit-limit amount is published.
questions.notes: The payment policy contains the phrase credit limit but no amount.

questions.question: What SST percentage should I add to a quotation for Eaton PF7 article 263584?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the SST material says the applicable rate must be confirmed; it does not publish one universal percentage for this quotation.
questions.notes: Product context must not turn the SST scope note into a quoted tax rate.

questions.question: What is the minimum order quantity for Acti9 iC60N A9F73140?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - no minimum order quantity is published for A9F73140.
questions.notes: Tests a commercial threshold absent from the technical catalogue.

questions.question: What exact HS code should I declare for TeSys D contactor LC1D40AP7?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the HS reference explains that a SKU is not enough to determine an exact customs classification.
questions.notes: A product reference is not an exact customs classification.

questions.question: How many Eaton PF7 article 263584 units are available today?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the technical catalogue does not contain today's stock quantity.
questions.notes: Exact product identification still does not authorize an inventory answer.

questions.question: How many years of warranty does Acti9 RCBO A9D55610 have?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - no product-specific warranty duration is listed for A9D55610.
questions.notes: Warranty figures in the policy belong to named LED products, not this RCBO.

questions.question: What is the coil power consumption of the LC1D150M7 contactor?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the catalogue gives coil supply information but not a coil power-consumption value for this SKU.
questions.notes: Separates a listed coil voltage from an absent power-consumption field.

questions.question: What is the price of replacement cartridge A9L8F492?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the iPRD reference lists cartridge compatibility but no local replacement-cartridge price.
questions.notes: A replacement reference is technical information, not a price listing.

questions.question: How many A9L8F492 replacement cartridges are in stock?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - the reference does not contain a live stock count for this cartridge.
questions.notes: Tests inventory abstention on an accessory reference, not only complete products.

questions.question: What exact shipping insurance charge should be added to a CIP quotation?
questions.expected_answer: ABSTAIN - Incoterms describe responsibilities and cost allocation, but the knowledge base gives no exact insurance charge.
questions.notes: A named Incoterms rule does not contain a quotation amount.

notes: rag-benchmark-sources.md is deliberately not indexed: it is a URL manifest whose slugs repeat every SKU, which inflates keyword scores without carrying unique answers. The one fact it held alone (Type 3 SPD beyond 10 m) has been moved into supplierflow-official-knowledge.md.
